qualification: Local independent native complete-image/cold recovery and headless application tests. No Windows/Microsoft Access comparison or complete SQL conformance claim.
observations: UNIQUE creation and drop use distinct nominal TCIC0004/profile4 and TCID0002/profile2 originals. Private native policy is retained through candidate/effect and checked before ordinary or unique original capture; equal output bytes cannot retag a candidate.

Fresh reconstruction checks complete original source binding, actual table/field/index identities, policy and whole AFTER before V3 preparation or recovery. Pending, mixed, committed and settled states remain checked. Old-family and no-create refusal boundaries stay explicit.

Actual ordinary LONG CREATE/UPDATE/INSERT and UNIQUE DROP share existing mutation/constraint owners; duplicate and Required violations have no published partial native effect. Alias survival protects the shared physical tree/map; final-owner drop retires only certified exclusive storage.

Runtime SQL View applies an explicit ANSI89 host default only to an observed Absent database setting. Explicit ANSI89/92 override it and Unknown never defaults. Raw observations and generic unsupplied query/adapter policies remain distinct.

One captured worker Environment forwards optional NumberFormat and DateTextFormat to reads, discovery, SELECT INTO, VALUES/SELECT insertion and UPDATE/DELETE, including correlated/joined evaluation. Display formatting, collation and OS UI locale do not select expression policies.

Action admission explicitly adds deterministic pure math/CStr, CDate/DateValue/TimeValue and DateAdd/DateDiff/DatePart through existing query kernels. Eager errors, original-row assignment, missing-format and missing-calendar failures remain typed; VBA/runtime calls are not activated.

Acknowledged same-document row saves retain presentation tab IDs while binding reconstructed empty sessions to the fresh document revision. Old tabs/row targets/reviews/results/native handles cannot authorize or publish fresh data; saved inputs and SQL/QBE preferences are inert and never rerun automatically.

The desired four-tab saved-query UPDATE uses a newly authored genuine canonical ACE16 ordinary dense-table source with complete MSysQueries/catalog/map/LVAL representation. Existing read-only fixtures and native source guards remain unchanged.

The final checkpoint combines successful production-source jobs with targeted query/UI/strict reruns after two test-only fixes. Counts overlap and cannot be summed into a conformance total; the two native and one Runtime ignored tests remain excluded.
